title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. translated_title: LooM：面向因果编码器-解码器语言模型的循环不变内存
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复执行共享层来增加有效深度，但三个限制阻碍了其应用：内存随循环次数增长、计算只能以整块为单位进行调整、以及循环次数在训练后难以更改。我们提出了LooM（循环不变内存），依次解决这些问题。在因果编码器-解码器（CED）架构中，LooM仅循环第一层之后的解码器层，这些层读取每个token仅写入一次的全局内存，并且每个层仅在首次访问某个token时发布其键值（KV）条目，因此缓存不会随循环次数增长。这些层独立循环，可提供每个token从3到21次层执行的任意计算预算，一个在随机采样预算上训练的模型无需路由器即可覆盖所有预算。在循环次数足够的情况下，LooM在语言建模、零样本准确率和长上下文困惑度上均优于在相同数据上训练的单次执行基线，同时使用……
tldr: LooM通过循环不变内存机制和独立循环的解码器层，使循环Transformer的KV缓存不随循环次数增长，无需路由器即可灵活调整每个token的计算预算（3到21次层执行），并在语言建模等任务上超越单次执行基线。
en_tdlr: LooM introduces loop-invariant memory for causal encoder-decoder language models, keeping the KV cache independent of loop count while enabling flexible per-token compute budgets (3-21 layer executions) without a router, and outperforming single-pass baselines on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy, and long-context perplexity.
